body.not_found: Error message shown when a blog post URL does not match any existing article.
body.published_on: Label shown next to the publication date on a blog post. Followed by a date. Keep short.
body.modified_on: Label shown next to the last modification date on a blog post. Followed by a date. Keep short.
body.min_read: Label shown next to the estimated reading time. Preceded by a number (e.g. '3 min read'). Keep short.
body.related_posts: Section heading shown above a list of related blog posts at the bottom of an article. Keep short.
body.and: Conjunction used to join two items in a list, e.g. two author names or two model names. Single word.
body.ai_assisted_label: Short badge label shown inline on a blog post to indicate AI-assisted writing. Shown as a clickable link that scrolls to the AI disclosure section.
body.ai_assisted_about_title: Section heading for the AI disclosure block at the bottom of a blog post.
body.ai_assisted_txt: Body text of the AI disclosure block. Explains how AI was used in writing the post and what the author verified. Contains a placeholder for the AI model name(s). Keep formal and precise.
body.ai_translated_label: Short badge label shown inline on a blog post to indicate the post was translated using AI. Shown similarly to the ai_assisted_label.
body.all_posts: Link label shown at the bottom of a blog post. Links back to the main blog listing page.
